title: C++ Interfaces (Abstract Classes)
description: How C++ expresses interfaces with pure virtual functions and abstract classes: declaring a contract, implementing it, multiple inheritance for interfaces, and destroying polymorphic objects safely.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 如何以純虛擬函式與抽象類表達介面：宣告契約、實作介面、以多重繼承組合介面，以及安全地銷毀多型物件。

questions.prompt: What makes a class abstract in C++?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 C++ 中，是甚麼讓一個類別成為抽象類？

a.zh-Hant: 它宣告了至少一個純虛擬函式

b.zh-Hant: 它的所有成員函式都是虛擬函式

c.zh-Hant: 它的建構函式被宣告為 private

explanation.zh-Hant: 只要宣告或繼承至少一個純虛擬函式（以 `= 0` 宣告），類別就是抽象類。私有建構函式只是限制建立物件的方式，C++ 並沒有 `abstract` 關鍵字。

options.text: It declares at least one pure virtual function.
All of its member functions are virtual.
Its constructor is declared private.
It is declared with the `abstract` keyword.

questions.explanation: A class is abstract when it declares or inherits at least one pure virtual function (declared with `= 0`). A private constructor only restricts how objects are created, and C++ has no `abstract` keyword.

questions.prompt: `Shape` declares a pure virtual function. What happens when you write `Shape s;`?

prompt.zh-Hant: `Shape` 宣告了一個純虛擬函式。若寫下 `Shape s;` 會怎樣？

a.zh-Hant: 編譯錯誤：抽象類不可建立物件

b.zh-Hant: 可以編譯，但呼叫純虛擬函式時在執行期拋出例外

c.zh-Hant: 可以編譯，物件的虛擬表是空的

d.zh-Hant: 只有在 Shape 有虛擬解構函式時才能編譯

explanation.zh-Hant: 抽象類別無法實體化，編譯器會直接拒絕 `Shape s;`；只能宣告 Shape 的指標或參考，並讓它們指向具體的衍生類別物件。

options.text: A compile error: an abstract class cannot be instantiated.
It compiles, but calling the pure virtual function throws at run time.
It compiles, and the object's virtual table is empty.
It compiles only if Shape has a virtual destructor.

questions.explanation: Abstract classes cannot be instantiated, so the compiler rejects `Shape s;`. You may only declare pointers or references to Shape and bind them to concrete derived objects.

questions.prompt: An abstract class may still have data members and ordinary (non-virtual) member functions that derived classes inherit.

prompt.zh-Hant: 抽象類仍然可以有資料成員與一般（非虛擬）成員函式，供衍生類別繼承。

explanation.zh-Hant: 抽象與否只取決於是否有純虛擬函式；抽象類仍可擁有狀態、輔助函式，甚至建構函式（由衍生類別的建構函式呼叫）。

questions.explanation: Abstractness only depends on having a pure virtual function. The class can still carry state, helper functions and even a constructor, which derived constructors call.

questions.prompt: C++ provides an `interface` keyword for declaring interfaces.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 提供了 `interface` 關鍵字來宣告介面。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 沒有 `interface` 關鍵字（Java、C# 才有）；介面是一種慣例——只含純虛擬函式與虛擬解構函式的抽象類。

questions.explanation: C++ has no `interface` keyword (unlike Java or C#). An interface is a convention: an abstract class with only pure virtual functions plus a virtual destructor.

questions.prompt: Which statements about pure virtual functions are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於純虛擬函式的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 在函式宣告後加上 `= 0` 即可宣告

b.zh-Hant: 仍可在類別外提供定義，供衍生類別明確呼叫

c.zh-Hant: 宣告它的類別會成為抽象類

d.zh-Hant: 必須是 private，衍生類別才無法覆寫

explanation.zh-Hant: `virtual void draw() = 0;` 會使類別成為抽象類。純虛擬函式仍可在類別外提供本體（例如 `void Base::draw() {}`），衍生類別可用 `Base::draw()` 明確呼叫；存取權限與抽象性無關。

options.text: They are declared by appending `= 0` to the function declaration.
They may still have a definition outside the class that derived classes can call explicitly.
A class that declares one becomes abstract.
They must be private, otherwise derived classes could override them.

questions.explanation: `virtual void draw() = 0;` makes the class abstract, yet the function may still have an out-of-class body such as `void Base::draw() {}` that a derived override calls as `Base::draw()`. Access specifiers do not affect abstractness.

questions.prompt: Which statements about implementing several interfaces with multiple inheritance are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於以多重繼承實作多個介面的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 一個類別可以繼承多個介面類

b.zh-Hant: 若介面沒有資料成員，就不會出現典型的菱形資料問題

c.zh-Hant: 一個覆寫可同時滿足兩個介面宣告的相同純虛擬函式

d.zh-Hant: 基底清單中的每個介面都必須以虛擬繼承，否則無法編譯

explanation.zh-Hant: 多重介面繼承合法且常見。兩個基底宣告相同簽章的純虛擬函式，可由衍生類別的一個覆寫同時滿足；只有當共用的非虛擬基底會被重複複製（例如含資料成員）時才需要虛擬繼承，並非一律要求。

options.text: A class may inherit from more than one interface class.
If the interfaces have no data members, the classic diamond data problem does not arise.
One override can satisfy the same pure virtual function declared in two different interfaces.
Every interface in the base list must be inherited virtually, or the program will not compile.

questions.explanation: Multiple interface inheritance is legal and common. The same signature inherited from two bases is overridden by a single derived function, and virtual inheritance is only needed when a shared non-virtual base would be duplicated, not as a blanket rule.

questions.prompt: A pure virtual function is declared by appending `= ____` to its declaration.

prompt.zh-Hant: 純虛擬函式是在宣告後加上 `= ____` 來表示。

explanation.zh-Hant: `= 0` 語法把函式標記為純虛擬，並使類別成為抽象類；它不是函式的初始值。

questions.explanation: The `= 0` syntax marks the function pure virtual and makes the class abstract. It is a declarator, not an initializer for the function.

questions.prompt: Why should an abstract base class that is deleted through a base-class pointer have a virtual destructor?

prompt.zh-Hant: 為甚麼透過基底類別指標刪除物件時，抽象基底類別必須有虛擬解構函式？

model.zh-Hant: 透過基底指標刪除物件時，若解構函式不是虛擬的，只會靜態呼叫基底解構函式，衍生類別的成員與資源不會被釋放，行為未定義。加上虛擬解構函式後會先執行衍生解構函式，再執行基底解構函式，因此介面通常宣告 `virtual ~Interface() = default;`。

explanation.zh-Hant: 沒有 `virtual` 時，`delete basePtr` 只會執行基底解構函式，衍生部分會洩漏；加上後會先執行衍生解構函式，再執行基底解構函式。

answer.model: Deleting through a base pointer calls the destructor statically unless it is virtual. A virtual destructor makes the derived destructor run, so derived members and their resources are released; otherwise the behaviour is undefined. An interface therefore normally declares `virtual ~Interface() = default;`.

questions.explanation: Without `virtual`, `delete basePtr` runs only the base destructor and the derived part leaks; with it, the derived destructor runs first, then the base destructor.

questions.prompt: How does a general C++ abstract class differ from a pure interface (a protocol)?

prompt.zh-Hant: 一般的 C++ 抽象類與純介面（協定）有甚麼差別？

a.zh-Hant: 抽象類可以有資料與已實作的成員，純介面只宣告契約

b.zh-Hant: 抽象類不能有建構函式，介面則可以

c.zh-Hant: 抽象類必須標記 `final` 才能被繼承

d.zh-Hant: 純介面必須以 `interface` 關鍵字宣告

explanation.zh-Hant: 介面是抽象類的特例：只含純虛擬函式（加上虛擬解構函式）。一般抽象類還可以有狀態、protected 輔助函式與已實作的方法，因此混合了契約與實作。

options.text: An abstract class may carry data and implemented members, while a pure interface only declares a contract.
An abstract class cannot have a constructor, but an interface can.
An abstract class must be marked `final` before it can be inherited.
A pure interface must be declared with the `interface` keyword.

questions.explanation: An interface is the limiting case of an abstract class: only pure virtual functions plus a virtual destructor. A general abstract class can also hold state, protected helpers and implemented methods, mixing contract with implementation.

questions.prompt: A derived class declares new members but does not override the base's pure virtual function. What is the result?

prompt.zh-Hant: 衍生類別宣告了新成員，但沒有覆寫基底的純虛擬函式，結果是？

a.zh-Hant: 衍生類別仍是抽象類，建立其物件會編譯失敗

b.zh-Hant: 衍生類別變成具體類，呼叫時在執行期中止

c.zh-Hant: 只有在呼叫該函式時，連結器才回報缺少符號

d.zh-Hant: 編譯器會產生一個不做事項的預設本體

explanation.zh-Hant: 抽象性會繼承：在每個純虛擬函式都被覆寫之前，衍生類別仍是抽象類，無法建立物件，但仍可宣告其指標或參考。

options.text: The derived class is itself abstract, and creating an object of it is a compile error.
The derived class becomes concrete and the call aborts at run time.
The linker reports a missing symbol only when the function is called.
The compiler generates a default body that does nothing.

questions.explanation: Abstractness is inherited: the derived class stays abstract until every pure virtual function has an override. Only then can it be instantiated, although pointers and references to it are still allowed.
